steps.name: Fetch reviewed harness outside the Action checkout
steps.run:
git init "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-context-harness"
git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-context-harness" remote add origin https://github.com/dabsdamoon/my-little-skills.git
git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-context-harness" fetch --depth 1 origin 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-context-harness" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD

steps.name: Preserve PR evidence separately from Action config restoration
Check primary evidence before model execution
Require subscription OAuth
steps.run: if [ -z "$CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN" ]; then echo "::error::Set repository secret CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN using claude setup-token. No API fallback is configured."; exit 1; fi

with.prompt: Read ${{ runner.temp }}/product-context-harness/skills/product-context/SKILL.md and ${{ runner.temp }}/product-context-harness/skills/product-context/references/subscription-wiki.md. This configured PR event authorizes one bounded wiki update. Product evidence root is ${{ runner.temp }}/product-context-product. Inspect primary specs, decisions and implementation evidence, preserving all source documents and unanswered questions. For a new wiki plan only one concise /openwiki/quickstart.md page; for an existing wiki maintain at most three affected factual pages. Use context.files from product_context_status as the source inventory; avoid repository-wide exploration. Follow the minimal protocol example in the subscription reference, using the exact assigned job ID and repo://relative/path evidence. Reserve the final four turns for finish, status and recording review. Use the product_context MCP lifecycle; write page Markdown only under that evidence root/openwiki, submit sparse Claims, finish cleanly, then inspect status and record the exact review snapshot with explicit questions. Do not change source policies, approvals or code. Do not run git, install tools, call another model, reset the wiki, or bypass failed completion. A turn/page limit is a failure to finish: report it rather than declaring current.

steps.name: Report safe MCP and completion diagnostics
Verify completion and publish document changes
steps.run:
python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-context-harness/skills/product-context/scripts/pr_wiki.py" verify --repo "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-context-product" --state "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-context-state.json" --commit --publication-receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-context-publication.json"
gh auth setup-git
git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-context-product" push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$PR_BRANCH"
